topic: Most popular websites based on Tranco rank
metric: Website popularity based on aggregated ranking metrics

interpretations.label: Tranco Composite Rank
interpretations.description: A research-oriented composite ranking derived by combining multiple ranking lists (such as Alexa, Majestic, and Cisco Umbrella) to mitigate manipulation and volatility.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Tranco rank score (lower integer value indicates higher popularity/rank)
caveats: Tranco project data availability begins around 2018 (retrospective/historical list reconstructions or specific archived datasets may be needed for years prior to 2018)
Methodology changes across different versions of the Tranco list aggregation algorithm

interpretations.label: Unique Visitors / Monthly Active Users
interpretations.description: Total number of distinct individuals who visit a website over a specific calendar month.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Number of unique visitors counted in millions (Monthly)
caveats: Rely on panel-based estimates or publisher self-reports for years prior to widespread analytics tracking
Definitions of unique visitors can vary across measurement providers (e.g., Comscore, Similarweb)

interpretations.label: Page Views / Traffic Volume
interpretations.description: Total number of pages loaded or viewed by users on a given website over a specific time period.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Total page view count or traffic share percentage
caveats: Heavy skew toward content-heavy or multi-page sites versus single-page web applications
Bot traffic can distort historical page view measurements

preferredSources: Alexa Internet Archive (Wayback Machine snapshots for historical rank)
knownRisks: Tranco official daily/monthly lists only date back to 2018; data for 1995-2017 must rely on predecessor lists like Alexa or historical archives combined into Tranco-compatible formats
Domain ownership changes and mergers over a nearly 30-year span can affect historical continuity
